name: pattern_formation

stratum_semantics: Generation metadata, not mutually exclusive causal explanations under all allowed drives and lengths.

claim_eligibility.interpretation: Pilot eligibility resolution after the assigned reset, not a fitted physical constant or a mechanism-identification certificate.

version_policy: Explicit tenth experimental registration. Existing dynamics, scoring formulas, prior cohorts and seven-world null calibration remain unchanged; shared task/policy metadata versions and presentation audit hashes advance deliberately.
